# `vn_input_fixtures.csv` — the DAT-05 shared Vietnamese input fixture set

**Created:** 2026-08-25 (WP-0.2) · **Rows:** 39 · **Encoding:** BOM-less UTF-8

**Required by:** [`../docs/specs/2026-08-24-neural-encoder-smart-parser.md`](../docs/specs/2026-08-24-neural-encoder-smart-parser.md) §9.1, **DAT-05**
**Generated by:** [`../tools/ml-pilot/build_fixtures.py`](../tools/ml-pilot/build_fixtures.py) · **Read by:** [`../tools/ml-pilot/fixtures.py`](../tools/ml-pilot/fixtures.py)

---

## Why this file exists, and why there is only one of it

DAT-05 requires **a single** Vietnamese input fixture set, committed to the repository and versioned
with the code, that **every slice uses** rather than introducing its own.

Four acceptance criteria compare behaviour against this set:

| AC | Claim it makes | Categories it reads |
|---|---|---|
| **AC-06** | Tokenization reproduces the adopted encoder's **reference tokenizer** output | `diacritics`, `stripped`, `runtogether`, `abbrev` |
| **AC-13** | S1 ships with **no behaviour delta** — no parse output changes | all six |
| **AC-17** | Encoder output is **reproducible** for identical input within tolerance | `diacritics`, `stripped`, `runtogether`, `abbrev` |
| **AC-30** | **Preprocessing independence** — quality holds on stripped diacritics and run-together tokens with no segmentation or restoration step in the path | `diacritics` ↔ `stripped` pairs, `runtogether`, `abbrev` |

Without one committed set these are **four different claims wearing the same words**, and "no
behaviour delta" stops being comparable between slices. If a later slice needs a case this set does
not cover, **add it here** — do not fork the set. The fork is the failure mode this file exists to
prevent.

`empty` and `pathological` additionally serve **AC-28 / FLB-01**: the parse call must complete and
return the heuristic result for malformed input, with no exception escaping.

---

## Columns

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Id` | `F001`…`F039`. Stable. Cite fixtures by `Id` in reports and test names |
| `Category` | One of the six DAT-05 minima (below) |
| `PairId` | `P01`…`P08` on `diacritics` / `stripped` rows; empty elsewhere. **The mechanism AC-30 needs** — see below |
| `Input` | The fixture text, **escaped** — see below |
| `Note` | What the row is for, and whether it is a verbatim `collected_v4` row |

### `Input` is escaped, uniformly, on every row

Backslash escapes: `\\` → `\`, `\t` → tab, `\r` → CR, `\n` → LF.

**Every row is escaped, including the ones that need no escaping.** One code path, no conditional,
no consumer that handles the realistic rows correctly and the whitespace rows subtly wrong.
Vietnamese text contains no backslashes, so the realistic rows read exactly as written.

Without this, a whitespace-only fixture (` `, `\t \t`, `\n`) either does not survive a CSV round trip
or survives in a reader-dependent way — and AC-28's distinct empty/whitespace cases silently collapse
into one case that nobody notices has stopped being tested.

**Use `tools/ml-pilot/fixtures.py::load()`.** Do not hand-roll the unescape. **Never read this file
with PowerShell `Get-Content`** — it mangles BOM-less UTF-8 Vietnamese in this environment, which
corrupts every downstream comparison while appearing to work.

### `PairId` — why the pairs matter

AC-30 measures **preprocessing independence**. Comparing accuracy on unrelated diacritics inputs
against unrelated stripped inputs measures the two *samples*, not the *effect*. Each `PairId` links
one meaning written both ways, so the comparison is **within-pair** and the diacritics are the only
thing that changed.

---

## Categories

| Category | Rows | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `diacritics` | 8 | Correct Vietnamese with full diacritics. Paired |
| `stripped` | 8 | The **same 8 meanings** with diacritics removed. Paired |
| `runtogether` | 6 | Run-together tokens — `thigiuaky`, `baitapvenha`, `doancuoiky`; one row fuses a run-together label to a run-together subject |
| `abbrev` | 8 | Domain abbreviations — `tgk`, `btvn`, `xstk`, `csdl`, `ktvm`, `ktct`, `dacn`, `ttcs` |
| `empty` | 6 | `""`, `" "`, `"   "`, tabs, a bare newline, CRLF surrounded by spaces |
| `pathological` | 3 | 2 040 / 5 269 / 20 159 characters. The 2 040-char row contains **no whitespace at all** |

Realistic rows are drawn from `collected_v4.csv` — real collected student input — so the set reflects
how students actually type rather than how a developer imagines they do. Several are verbatim rows;
`Note` says which.

**Two rows deliberately name classes absent from the real evaluation subset** (`thicuoiky…`,
`kiemtrathuongxuyen…`). The 3-of-5 coverage limit (spec §6.1) bounds what S0 can *measure*; it is not
a reason for the fixture set to pretend those classes do not exist.

**Sizing.** The pathological rows are sized against the candidates' sequence limits (e5-small 512
tokens, EmbeddingGemma 2048) so truncation behaviour is actually exercised. Any input bounding the
implementation adds is `[choice]`, constrained only by the requirement that truncation must not
silently change a user-visible field without provenance saying so (spec §10).

---

## Verification

```
python tools/ml-pilot/fixtures.py
```

Asserts: valid BOM-less UTF-8 · all six categories non-empty · every `stripped` row has a
`diacritics` partner · the escaped whitespace rows survive the round trip distinctly · a genuinely
pathological input is present · no duplicate `Id`.

**Proven able to fail before its pass was trusted** (2026-08-25) — four mutations, each exiting 1:

| Mutation | Assertion that fired |
|---|---|
| Drop one `PairId` | `unpaired diacritics/stripped rows: {'', 'P03'}` |
| Replace the escaped `empty` inputs with a plain token | `no empty-string fixture survived the round trip` |
| Truncate the `pathological` inputs | `no genuinely pathological input present` |
| Inject an invalid UTF-8 byte | `UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xff` |

Restored file re-verifies green (exit 0).

---

## Regenerating

`build_fixtures.py` is deterministic — re-running produces a byte-identical file. Regenerate only to
**add** rows; changing or removing an existing row changes what AC-13's "no behaviour delta"
compares against, and must be noted in the slice that does it.

**SHA-256 at creation:** `283d048e85d064a2e47c3f6a70edaef7af5ed7da37fcc99846d105480ad3b98a`

## Where this file is loaded from

S0 reads it from disk at `datasheets/vn_input_fixtures.csv` — it lives outside `SmartStudyPlanner/`
so S0 does not mutate the production project (EVA-01), and outside `tools/ml-pilot/` so it is not
throwaway. **S1 (WP-1.5) adds the test-project include** and asserts the test project loads *this*
path.
